seo.title: Food Menu | The Talisman Restaurant, Karen, Nairobi
seo.description: See The Talisman’s main menu, weekend breakfast and afternoon tea. Farm-grown produce, house-smoked salmon and eclectic dishes in Karen, Nairobi.

food.text: Our chef cooks specials every day from what the farm sends up. Come in and ask what’s on today.

main_menu_image.alt: Fish on a creamy sauce with herb oil

food.main_menu_text: Lunch and dinner, from the farm and the fire.
food.breakfast_text: Eggs, sourdough and strong coffee, weekends from nine.
food.afternoon_tea_text: Scones, cake and a pot for the table.

image.alt: A heap of fresh peppers for the Talisman kitchen

farmers.heading:
We know who
*grows it.*
farmers.text: Herbs and greens from our own farm, picked at dawn. The rest from smallholders we have known for years.

preparation.heading:
One fire,
*kept deliberately low.*
preparation.text: Salmon cured and smoked here. Stocks reduced overnight, bread baked at dawn.

image.alt: Whole sides of salmon hanging over the fire in the Talisman smokehouse
A hot chocolate and a biscuit on a wooden table by the fire

afternoon-tea.heading:
Three o’clock,
*in the green.*
afternoon-tea.text: Sandwiches, warm scones and cakes, served from three until half past five.
